DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (Reiter's Syndrome) secondary to Chlamydia trachomatis infection.

The combination of asymmetric oligoarthritis (ankle followed by knee), urethritis (pain with urination), recent sexual activity, and inflammatory markers strongly supports this diagnosis. The family history of rheumatoid arthritis is likely a red herring given the acute, self-resolving nature of your first episode.
